records.title: Completion of Halwara Airport
details:
(a) to (c): At Air Force Station Halwara, a joint venture between the Airports Authority of India (AAI) and the State Government of Punjab has been formed to develop a new Civil
Enclave.

records.title: YUGE YUGEEN BHARAT NATIONAL MUSEUM IN NEW DLEHI.
details: a to b: It includes the transformation of two blocks of symmetrical buildings into museum space for the creation of a new National Museum elucidating the thousands-year-old civilization and cultural heritage. An agreement has been signed on 19th December, 2024 between National Museum & France Museums Development for the technical cooperation for the development of the upcoming museum.

records.title: Pending Projects under PMAY-G
details: a: The Union Cabinet has approved an additional 2 crore rural houses under PMAY-G to be constructed in the next five years from FY 2024-25 to FY 2028-29 to meet the arising housing requirements due to increase in the number of families in rural areas across the country.
